answer: Concrete Sybil defense: stake-weighted identity. Each agent locks scarce collateral for one vote, and fraud slashes that bond, so spawning cheap clones cannot multiply influence. To buy a fake majority an attacker must fund every identity separately, staking real basalt, juniper, and plume value for each one. Splitting an honest agent into a thousand sybils merely divides the same capital without adding votes, while every clone's stake stays seizeable. Cost rises linearly with each fake identity, so the attack never pays.
